hero.headline: Your Property,
hero.subheadline: Chabrin Agencies delivers end-to-end property management, leasing, and valuation services across Nairobi, Kiambu, Murang'a, Kajiado, Machakos, and beyond.

services_section.title: Full-Spectrum Property Services
services_section.subtitle: From finding the right tenant to managing your entire portfolio — Chabrin delivers professional property services across Nairobi, Kiambu, Murang'a, Kajiado, Machakos, and surrounding counties.
services_section.management_desc: End-to-end management of residential and commercial properties. Rent collection, maintenance coordination, tenant relations, and monthly reporting.
services_section.leasing_desc: Professional tenant sourcing, vetting, and placement. We handle lease preparation, digital signing, and handover documentation.
services_section.valuation_desc: Accurate market valuations for residential, commercial, and industrial properties across our coverage area — backed by current data and deep local expertise.
services_section.facilities_desc: Planned and reactive maintenance, contractor management, and compliance oversight to protect the long-term value of your property.

why_chabrin.title: The Chabrin Standard
why_chabrin.subtitle: We measure ourselves against what matters to landlords and tenants — transparency, responsiveness, and results.
why_chabrin.licensed_desc: Registered with the Estate Agents Registration Board (EARB) and compliant with the Kenya Data Protection Act. Your property is in safe, accountable hands.
why_chabrin.responsive_desc: Every property is assigned a dedicated manager — not a call centre. Direct communication, fast response times, and real accountability.
why_chabrin.tech_desc: Powered by our proprietary management platform for real-time reporting, digital lease signing, and transparent financial tracking for every landlord.
why_chabrin.local_desc: 30+ years of on-the-ground experience across Nairobi, Kiambu, Murang'a, Kajiado, Machakos, and beyond. We know the market, the regulations, and the right price.

cta_banner.title: Let Us Manage Your Property
cta_banner.subtitle: Join hundreds of landlords who trust Chabrin to maximise their rental income, minimise vacancy, and handle everything in between.

about.hero_subtitle: For over 30 years, Chabrin Agencies Limited has been the trusted partner for property management, leasing, and real estate valuation — delivering professional, transparent service across Nairobi, Kiambu, Murang'a, Kajiado, Machakos, and beyond.
about.mission_text: To provide property owners and tenants across Kenya with a trustworthy, efficient, and professional management service that protects asset value and enhances the living and working experience.
about.vision_text: To be East Africa's most respected property management firm — recognised for integrity, innovation, and the enduring relationships we build with every client.
about.values_subtitle: The principles that guide everything we do at Chabrin Agencies.
about.value_integrity_desc: We operate with complete transparency and honesty in every transaction.
about.value_professionalism_desc: Our team holds the highest standards of conduct and service delivery.
about.value_excellence_desc: We continuously improve to exceed client expectations.
about.value_innovation_desc: We embrace technology and data to stay ahead of the market.
about.milestone_1990s_desc: Chabrin Agencies Limited was established in Nairobi, Kenya — beginning with residential property management across the city's key neighbourhoods.
about.milestone_2000s_desc: Steadily expanded the managed portfolio, deepening roots across Nairobi's zones while extending coverage to Kiambu County towns along Thika Road and towards Kenol in Murang'a County.
about.milestone_2010_desc: Attained full registration with the Estate Agents Registration Board of Kenya, cementing our professional standing and regulatory compliance.
about.milestone_2015_desc: Expanded into commercial property management and professional valuation services, growing to over 400 managed properties across 7 zones (A–G).
about.milestone_2020_desc: Launched our proprietary property management platform to digitise workflows, streamline rent collection, enhance tenant communication, and provide real-time landlord reporting.
about.milestone_2024_desc: Introduced digital lease signing, online rent payment tracking, and this public-facing web portal serving landlords and tenants across all our zones — Nairobi, Kiambu, Murang'a, Kajiado, Machakos, and beyond.
about.leadership_subtitle: Experienced professionals committed to delivering exceptional property management across all our zones.
about.accreditations_subtitle: Our credentials and compliance frameworks give landlords and tenants complete confidence.
about.badge_earb_desc: Estate Agents Registration Board — Kenya's official real estate regulator.
about.badge_odpc_desc: Fully compliant with the Kenya Data Protection Act 2019.
about.badge_company_desc: Incorporated and in good standing with the Registrar of Companies, Kenya.
about.badge_years_desc: Serving Kenya's property market since the 1990s.
about.accreditations_cta_title: Ready to work with Kenya's trusted property managers?
about.accreditations_cta_subtitle: Whether you're a landlord across Nairobi, Kiambu, Murang'a, Kajiado, Machakos, or beyond — or a tenant seeking your next home — we're here to help.

services_page.hero_subtitle: From single units to large portfolios — Chabrin provides the full range of professional property services that landlords and tenants across Nairobi, Kiambu, Murang'a, Kajiado, Machakos, and beyond rely on.
services_page.management_desc: We take full responsibility for your property — so you can focus on what matters most to you. Our dedicated managers handle every aspect of the day-to-day, from rent collection to maintenance.
services_page.management_f1: Monthly rent collection and financial reporting
services_page.management_f4: Compliance with landlord-tenant law in Kenya
services_page.leasing_desc: We market your property across multiple channels, vet every applicant rigorously, and handle all documentation from lease drafting through to digital signing and handover.
services_page.valuation_desc: Our registered valuers provide independent, reliable market valuations for residential, commercial, and industrial properties — essential for sales, mortgages, insurance, and legal purposes.
services_page.valuation_f2: Market rental and capital value assessments
services_page.valuation_f4: Valuation reports meeting bank and legal standards
services_page.facilities_desc: Proper maintenance isn't just about fixing problems — it's about preventing them. Our facilities team ensures your property is always in optimal condition.
services_page.process_subtitle: Getting started with Chabrin is straightforward. Here is our onboarding process for new landlords.
services_page.step1_desc: We meet with you to understand your property, your goals, and your expectations.
services_page.step2_desc: Our team conducts a thorough inspection and market analysis of your property.
services_page.step3_desc: We prepare a clear, fair management contract with transparent fees and terms.
services_page.step4_desc: We take over day-to-day management, keeping you informed with regular reports.
services_page.step5_desc: Monthly financial statements, maintenance logs, and occupancy reports — always on time.
services_page.landlord_desc: Get a free consultation and find out how Chabrin can improve your rental income and take the hassle out of property ownership.
services_page.tenant_desc: Browse our available residential and commercial properties across all our zones — Nairobi, Kiambu, Murang'a, Kajiado, Machakos, and surrounding areas.
